script_text: Aquarius, Uranus — your ruling planet paired with Air — fires a volatile square with Mars in Aries, shifting this week unexpectedly. Wednesday carries Venus sextile Uranus, a rare activation awakening deep romantic desire you never sensed. Wednesday pivots mid-week as Venus enters your 5th House trining natal Uranus, unlocking hidden romantic and creative energy. Thursday through Saturday, the Sun in the 8th House amplifies shared finances and intimate conversations with a partner. Sunday, Moon in your 10th House spotlighting your career path. Thursday is your power day because the Sun enters the 8th House supercharging shared wealth and passionate romance. Tuesday is your worst day — Mars square Uranus igniting unnecessary conflict. Triple-check every document and contract before Wednesday — Mercury's shadow still lingers. Follow for your daily astrology updates.
